decisive_items: 4 symmetric concentric ring-shaped opacities in posterior corneal stroma
long bandlike structures with thin streaks of white lines interspersed
response.rationale: R3 matches the symmetric posterior stromal rings and confocal bandlike streaks typical of corneal amyloidosis; R5 only describes peripheral crocodile shagreen, a secondary finding.

rejected.why: Peripheral crocodile shagreen is present but not the dominant ring pattern; lacks the confocal bandlike structures.
Smooth rings without deposits or pigmentation do not support lipoidal degeneration; no lipid evidence.
Normal serum iron contradicts iron deposition; rings are not typical iron lines.
